$description: GENERATED by brand/scripts/palettes.mjs from brand/inputs/brand-inputs.json + the Beatham ramps in color.base.json — do not edit (npm run brand:palettes). OKLCH, 9 steps, each step’s lightness matched to the Beatham neutral of the same number. Raw palette: products use semantic colours only.

callout.$description: Callout (blue) — signal.info: still open, still free. Jeremiah’s Callout ramp, OKLCH-corrected (HandCAD decision #23): his 10–40 and 70–90 verbatim; 50 and 60 lifted onto the neutral lightness targets (hue and chroma kept).

negative.$description: Negative (red) — signal.negative: broken (error, conflict, failed, destructive) and, one step lighter, signal.caution / warnings. Jeremiah’s Negative ramp exactly as drawn (HandCAD decision #24); it already sits within 0.016 L of every neutral step.

success.$description: Success (green) — signal.positive: results that passed a check (✓), never “saved”. Jeremiah’s Success ramp, OKLCH-corrected (HandCAD decision #25): only 60 moves.

gold.$description: Gold → brown, rebuilt in OKLCH (HandCAD decision #26): his gold swatches 1, 2, 5 and 6 verbatim at 10, 20, 30 and 90; 40–80 are new mid browns on the neutral targets. His 3 and 4 map to brand/40 and brand/50 (same lightness), 7 to brown/90 and 8 is brown/100. Marketing, illustration, packaging and the Gilt palette — never a semantic role.

brown.$description: Brown — the dark end of the Beatham amber → brown ramp as its own lightness-matched ramp (HandCAD decisions #3, #26): brand/70 verbatim at 60, brand/90 verbatim at 90, brown/80 is brand/80 moved onto the neutral/80 lightness (hue and chroma kept), and his deepest gold swatch (#110602) is brown/100. Marketing, illustration, packaging and the Gilt palette — never a semantic role.

filament-grey.$description: Filament grey — his photo-sampled filaments as a cool grey ramp: light gray (30), space gray (70) and black (90) verbatim; the other steps are the same cool grey (C 0.006, h 262) on the neutral targets. For showing printed parts on screen and the physical roles (subbrand grants, scope physical).

filament-orange.$description: Filament orange — his orange filament verbatim at 40; the other steps keep its hue on the neutral lightness targets. Physical roles only (the part you actuate).
